Call in now to make your witness on Cuomo Mornings on POTUS channel 124 @SIRIUSXM 

Call In 866-967-6887

Trump set a deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz --but if it expires without a deal, it forces a decision that will make an already unstable situation even worse.

Join The Chris Cuomo Project on YouTube for ad-free episodes, early releases, exclusive access to Chris, and more: piped.video/p9S7PJH5r1I

Video
Tell me how you voted for a trump to "destroy a civilization"

Is anything good that does not echo your agenda?


Mehdi Hasan (@mehdirhasan)

Ok this is actually pretty good - not just because he is pushing back against the rightwing mockery of Islam but, for the first time, Tucker is breaking with Trump, directly criticizing him. That’s bold, given his base.



— https://nitter.net/mehdirhasan/status/2041318518050738275#m
Where trump is in iran was totally foreseeable. And where it goes is as well. Proof:  piped.video/p9S7PJH5r1I

And you think you have proved them wrong?


Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

Yes



— https://nitter.net/elonmusk/status/2041398810170237381#m

I guess I am stupid but it is helpful to understand what point you are trying to make as opposed to a "vote for me" declaration


Ed Krassenstein (@EdKrassen)

Because I’m attacked constantly because I’m Jewish.  I think my post is just common sense but apparently a lot of people don’t get it.



— https://nitter.net/EdKrassen/status/2041489241796944052#m

Shouldn't you explain why you changed?


Joe Kent (@joekent16jan19)

Tapper’s purpose, like the entire corporate media, is to promote this foolish war & attack anyone who points out how this war isn’t in our nation’s interest.

Read independent media, Iranian media & US media - always question those cheering on wars & always pray for our troops.



— https://nitter.net/joekent16jan19/status/2041140400304337063#m

Explaining on twitter is losing. Too much is treated as sport and playing for provocation.


Jake Tapper 🦅 (@jaketapper)

Anyone who watches the coverage on @TheLeadCNN/@CNNSOTU knows I don’t “promote” the war. We cover it, critically.

Moreover, I wasn’t attacking Mr. Kent. I pointed out that he had promoted false information suggesting the US was seeking to *kill* the missing US pilot. Wild stuff.



— https://nitter.net/jaketapper/status/2041154209832161335#m

These guys are about clicks. Tucker was saying to nuke iran for its terror efforts like a year ago.


𝐍𝐢𝐨𝐡 𝐁𝐞𝐫𝐠 🇮🇷 ✡︎ (@NiohBerg)

My idea of heroism is risking your life to save a soldier trapped behind enemy lines, not crying on a podcast





— https://nitter.net/NiohBerg/status/2041321095555375500#m

Proof graham never played football


Sean Hannity 🇺🇸 (@seanhannity)

Sen. Lindsey Graham says the goal is clear: no nukes, no missiles, no terrorism.  He says President Trump has Iran on the brink and “inside the 10 yard line” with a deal

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/seanhannity/status/2041331597387923806#m

Please tell me you get how un-american this is?  You sound like the crackers who said my grandparents we're not welcome because Italians are all criminals


Brandon Gill (@realBrandonGill)

We will never stop Sharia law until we stop Muslim immigration.



— https://nitter.net/realBrandonGill/status/2041223038365020466#m

If everybody in charge is dead… Who are the people who keep saying no to cease-fire and giving Trump the middle finger? If they have no weapons, what are these things that keep hitting Israel and the surrounding region and that took down our fighter jets?


Scott Jennings (@ScottJenningsKY)

The new talking point on the left is that the Iranian regime is "still in charge."

The people who were in charge are DEAD. Their military is decimated. The person supposedly in charge now has never been see

BY DESIGN. Regulate the algorithms...no media platform gets away with what they do


gino.eth 💽 (@GinoTheGhost)

I think the more alarming thing about this chart isn’t that it’s so right-leaning, it’s the accounts at the top.

Rage-bait misinformative political slop accounts are rewarded above all else.



— https://nitter.net/GinoTheGhost/status/2041162055630364792#m

They are doing what drives clicks. The algorithm is DESIGNED to preference outrage...enragement is the preferred engagement.


Eyal Yakoby (@EYakoby)

Why is the podcaster class rooting against the U.S. military?



— https://nitter.net/EYakoby/status/2041291101697433945#m

Why are you telling us this? Seriously...explain why you need this clarification...it matters


Ed Krassenstein (@EdKrassen)

I am Jewish.
I am an American.
I have family in Israel.
I support Israel’s right to exist.
I do NOT support this war.
I do not support Netanyahu.
I do not support Trump. 
I do not support the Iranian regime.
I do not support Hamas. 
I support the people of Israel. 
I support the people of Iran.
I support the people of Gaza.
I support the people of America. 
I support the

How stupid do you think people are?  The RULE is you get paid in and after serving....and you know it


Mila Joy (@Milajoy)

Pete Hegseth’s salary was an est. $2.3 million in 2024.

His new salary is $256K. 

Jeanine Pirro made $5,000,000 in 2024.

Her new salary is $198,000.

Sean Duffy made an est. $1 Million last year.

His new salary is $253K. 

They aren't in it for the money.

They are in it for love of country. 

Pure patriots. 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸









— https://nitter.net/Milajoy/status/204099209

Admit you lied abt WMD


Ari Fleischer (@AriFleischer)

The reason many Jews vote Democrat is because for them abortion is more important than Israel. 

Sad to say, the existence of Israel is not that important, especially compared to liberal social policies.



— https://nitter.net/AriFleischer/status/2041216544487747603#m
